events.title: Devlog #3 - A-MEAN-able Amenities
events.summary: Greetings Spooky Friends! As we count down the final days of summer, we're checking the weather forecast for the first days of fall weather. I've been hard at work making building ghost, rooms, and features. Today's devlog will go over a few of them. And we've got some big news: Inn Kreeper is participating in Steam Next Fest this October!THE SODA BARThe Soda Bar allows you to serve strawberry and apple sodas to your guests with their free Soda Bar pass. events.title: Devlog #2 - What's cooking?
events.summary: Hello again!This summer has been incredibly warm, as I'm sure many of you have experienced. I've retreated to my basement to escape the heat and put the finishing touches on some new features for Inn Kreeper.Here's what's cooking.Inn Kreeper originally began as a game jam project I made for Halloween. events.title: Devlog #1 — Welcome to the Inn!
events.summary: Hello everyone!
